quote: Holcim agreed to acquire from the Sellers 99.99% of the issued and outstanding shares of common stock of Inversiones … in exchange for an aggregate cash purchase price of S/1,850,370,000 (the “Inversiones Acquisition”). The Inversiones Acquisition was consummated on March 30, 2026.
